typed_links.link: The five zot-torat superscriptions (MT 6:2,6:7,6:18,7:1,7:11) and the closing colophons (7:37-38, 11:46, 12:7) form one verified register system; assignments verified correct by the OL primaries.
The second-person generalizing codas (2:11-13, 3:17, 7:22-27 family, 11:41-45) are one genre; the 2:11-13 split ruling applied the same criterion that keeps 3:17 standalone.
The refrain-closed Moses-transmission notices at 21:24, 23:44, and 24:23 receive one treatment (standalone) after the 21:24 split aligned the third site with the other two.
